en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a pastoral town view. In the foreground are several multi‑story houses beside a street with a tram or railcar and a few people. Behind them are rolling hills and fields. On the left hilltop stands a large baroque church or basilica with twin towers. The lower border contains ornate printed text in German, and the rest of the card is filled with handwritten cursive text in purple ink along the top and right margins. The style is late‑19th‑century.
